import pathlib, textwrap, importlib.util
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def _components(grid, color):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append(comp)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Locate the connected L-shaped marker. It is the non-background
    # component made from one full horizontal and one full vertical arm.
    marker=None
    for color in set(v for row in g for v in row)-{bg}:
        for comp in _components(g,color):
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if len(comp) < 3: continue
            cells=set(comp)
            corners=[(r,c) for r,c in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)) if (r,c) in cells and sum((r==rr or c==cc) for rr,cc in cells)>0]
            # An L has exactly two occupied sides of its bounding box and
            # includes their common corner.
            for er,ec in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
                if (er,ec) not in cells: continue
                vertical={(r,ec) for r in range(r0,r1+1)}
                horizontal={(er,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)}
                if vertical|horizontal == cells and len(vertical & cells)>=2 and len(horizontal & cells)>=2:
                    marker=(color,comp,(er,ec),r0,r1,c0,c1)
                    break
            if marker: break
        if marker: break
    if marker is None: return g
    color,comp,(er,ec),r0,r1,c0,c1=marker
    # The L points away from its two arms into the diagonally opposite
    # quadrant. Recolor the nearest separate object in that quadrant.
    dr=1 if er==r0 else -1 # opposite vertical arm
    dc=1 if ec==c0 else -1 # opposite horizontal arm
    candidates=[]
    for other in set(v for row in g for v in row)-{bg,color}:
        for obj in _components(g,other):
            cy=sum(r for r,c in obj)/len(obj); cx=sum(c for r,c in obj)/len(obj)
            if (cy-er)*dr>0 and (cx-ec)*dc>0:
                d=min((r-er)**2+(c-ec)**2 for r,c in obj)
                candidates.append((d, -len(obj), obj))
    if candidates:
        obj=min(candidates,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))[2]
        for r,c in obj: g[r][c]=color
    return g
'''
